verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's conditional access page documents that access is revoked automatically when users are off a trusted network or a device falls out of compliance. That covers the network and device signals of the story, but only through a brief vendor marketing claim. missing for 10: location/geo-based conditions, risk-signal-driven policies, evidence of per-app and per-group policy scoping, in-depth policy configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
